title: upgrade: attention kernels -> FlashAttentionV2 + fused rotary/rope ops + KV batching improvements
author: Ethan Park
description:
Motivation: reduce per-token latency and increase throughput on a range of open models by upgrading attention kernels and fusing rotary/rope ops. This PR integrates FlashAttentionV2 kernels (with our local portability patches), adds a fused rotary/rope path to avoid separate elementwise passes, and wires kernel-level support into continuous batching and KV cache paths so that scheduling can exploit new memory and compute characteristics.

Changes: 1) Add FlashAttentionV2 kernel variants with runtime selection based on sequence length and device capability. 2) Implement fused rotary/rope operator that runs inside the attention kernel for reduced memory traffic. 3) Update KV cache encode/decode hooks to maintain compatibility with fused kernels and to allow compressed KV layout under certain batch shapes. 4) Scheduler tweaks: prefer fused-kernel friendly batch packing and add heuristic to avoid splitting long-prefix requests across GPU boundaries when fused path selected. 5) Extensive benchmark harness and performance tests; added microbenchmarks comparing v1 vs v2 across seq-len 128/512/2048.

Notes: kept the PR focused on runtime integration only; model definitions unchanged. We include runtime feature flag FLASHATTV2_ENABLED (off by default on release branch) and an autoswitch policy that enables it for CUDA >= 12.1 and compute capability >= 8.6. The fused-rotary path is enabled when rotary embeddings are present and sequence length <= 2048; beyond that we fall back to existing path to avoid kernel memory blowup.

Benchmarks (internal): - GPT-style 13B, batch 1: latency p50 reduced ~18% (seq 512) and p99 ~12%. - Llama-2-70B (sharded test infra, batch 1): p50 reduced ~10% at seq 2048, throughput increased ~7% with fused KV layout. - Throughput (continuous batching sim): overall tokens/sec improved 12% on Ampere A100 80GB in our perf lab. Memory: peak GPU memory reduced ~6% for fused-rotary cases.

Compatibility/Testing: unit tests for attention kernels and transformer API added; CI includes synthetic perf checks (smoke) and regression tests against kv cache serialization. Ran end-to-end smoke on dedicated cluster; one flaky benchmark triggered re-run and passed.

Deployment plan: feature-flag rollout to canary Dedicated pool for 48 hours, monitor latency SLOs and token-cost delta. If regressions >5% on p99, auto-roll back.

References: linked Linear items (ENG-7245, ENG-7301) and internal design doc (link removed for public PR).
